more.question: N6
more.good_when: A developer reading the concept sees how invoicer's one way, an invoice whose totals are right without anyone redoing the math, keeps holding at every moment they and the accounting team meet the product, including the developer installing the command once for the accounting team and the developer updating invoicer under their own code. Today the install moment, which O3 is about, has no idea behind it, so a developer choosing how the command gets installed or set up finds nothing in the concept to lean that choice on; and the idea for updating says the library rounds 'the same way every time' without saying it stays the same across updates, so a developer can't tell from it whether their own code keeps its results after an update.
